plan.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
plan.logline: A lighthouse keeper must choose between saving a ship's last survivor or keeping the lighthouse's guiding light.
plan.ending: The survivor is safely ashore, and the keeper faces the moral cost of her decision.
world_rules: The lighthouse is the only source of light in a vast, dark ocean.
The keeper must navigate the lighthouse's limited power supply.
The ship's last survivor is the only hope for the stranded sailors.

characters.name: Lighthouse Keeper
characters.appearance: A middle-aged woman with a stern expression and a lighthouse key.
characters.goal: To rescue the last survivor of a ship lost at sea.

characters.name: Last Survivor
characters.appearance: A young man with a desperate look in his eyes.
characters.goal: To be rescued and reach safety.

locations.name: Lighthouse
locations.description: The keeper's home, the only source of light in the vast ocean.

locations.name: Ocean
locations.description: The vast, dark ocean where the ship is lost.

episodes.title: The Lighthouse Keeper
episodes.summary: The keeper receives a message from the ship's last survivor, and she must decide whether to save the man or keep the lighthouse's guiding light.
episodes.outcome: The keeper chooses to save the man, and the survivor is safely ashore. The keeper must now face the cost of her decision.

The Lighthouse Keeper

[Shot 1: 5.0s]

The lighthouse keeper, Lighthouse Keeper (d0a3b0e5-edc6-5c52-bb94-fc67b74346f2), stands at the edge of the lighthouse, her stern face reflecting the vastness of the ocean. She holds a lighthouse key, a symbol of her authority and the lighthouse's power.

[Shot 2: 5.0s]

The ocean, a dark expanse stretching to the horizon. The ship's last survivor, Last Survivor (0cc02a69-3402-5306-919f-b6b8d6842bb0), is at the ship's bow, his eyes filled with desperation.
